results.description:
NO STREAK COUNTER. There isn't one anywhere in this tracker — on purpose.
A SCORE INSTEAD. Doing the habit adds a point, missing costs half a point, and it never goes below zero.
UNDATED. Start in June, stop in August, pick it up again in March. A blank month is just a blank.

Printable PDF. Four sizes included: A4, US Letter, A5 and Half Letter.

─────────────────────────

WHY THERE IS NO STREAK

A streak that resets to zero turns one missed day into a reason to stop opening the tracker at all. You miss a Tuesday, the chain breaks, and the whole thing becomes evidence against you.

So this one keeps a score.

• You did the habit — add a point
• You did the lite version — add a point. It counts the same
• You missed it — take off half a point
